name: Joshua Aaron Rotenberg
headline: Customer Marketing & Lifecycle Manager | Retention, Expansion & Advocacy
summary: Customer marketing and lifecycle leader with 15+ years in B2B SaaS, building the onboarding, retention, and expansion programs that turn product usage and customer health signal into measurable engagement and revenue growth. Owns CRM segmentation and lifecycle-stage architecture end to end, manages cross-functional work with product, customer success, and marketing ops, and has directly led teams of up to 20 through two years of sustained delivery.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Develop and execute full-lifecycle customer strategies spanning demand generation, sales CRM architecture, and customer success, demonstrating clear ROI and revenue growth.
Design and deploy automated lifecycle sequences, onboarding workflows, and CRM architectures that activate, nurture, and retain high-value users at scale.
Architect and implement complex CRM systems in GoHighLevel (primary) and HubSpot, including contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, and strict data-hygiene protocols.
Identify strategic opportunities to expand retainer scope, recommending and scoping complementary services aligned with client objectives.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, delivering insights to executive leadership.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.
Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, translating performance data into strategic recommendations.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K, spanning health, home services, and retail verticals), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Advised partners on retention strategy, customer health metrics, and automated workflows, equipping them to communicate product value.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Developed scalable communication workflows and automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years, a team of 20 and later a team of 8, overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.
Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Led onboarding and launch operations as team lead and primary strategic contact, delivering launches on time and accelerating time-to-value.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google/Coursera (2024)
